group.label: Page Size
group.supertip: Layout of the specific document section, set of customized properties.

menu.label: Page Size
menu.supertip: Choose from the list of predefined formats. This will apply margins, header, footer, page orientation.

button.label: A4 Portait, mirrored margins 1.2 cm
button.supertip: The default layout. Sets the current section to A4 Portrait with 1.2 cm mirrored margins. Macro: SetPageLayout_A4_V_1_2

button.label: A4 Landscape, mirrored margins 1.2 cm
button.supertip: A4 Landscape orientation with mirrored margins equal to 1.2 cm. Macro: SetPageLayout_A4_H_1_2

button.label: A4 Portrait, no mirrored margins 0.5 cm
button.supertip: A4 Landscape orientation without mirrored margins equal to 0.5 cm. Macro: SetPageLayout_A4_H_0_5

button.label: A3 Landscape, no mirrored margins 0.5 cm
button.supertip: A3 Landscape orientation without mirrored margins equal to 0.5 cm. Macro: SetPageLayout_A3_H_0_5

button.label: A3 Portrait, mirrored margins 1.2 cm
button.supertip: A3 Landscape orientation with mirrored margins equal to 1.2 cm. Macro: SetPageLayout_A3_V_1_2

group.label: Blank Pages
group.supertip: If document section has odd number of pages, additional page is inserted with text explaining purpose of the blank page.

menu.label: Blank Pages
menu.screentip: Add / remove blank pages at the end of document section(s)
menu.supertip: Whenever number of pages in a document section is odd, blank page may be added to get even number of pages.

button.label: Add Blank Page
button.supertip: Inserts the A4_Ver_BlankPage building block at the end of any odd section in ActiveDocument.

button.label: Delete Blank Pages
button.supertip: Removes all building blocks marked with the TB_BlankPage bookmark.

button.label: Add Section
button.screentip: Adds new section with unlinked H/F
button.supertip: Inserts a next page section break at the cursor, breaks linking for headers and footers.

button.label: Unlink all H/F
button.supertip: Unlinks all headers and footers in the current document.

button.label: Add
button.supertip: Add custom document properties DocProperties and displays them in MsgBox.

button.label: Edit
button.supertip: Opens a user input User Interface form to edit document variables.

button.label: Delete All
button.supertip: Delete any document property except predefined.
